Customers porting from frameworks that round half away from zero get incorrect totals.\n\n**Repro approach.** Minimal **csproj console app** targeting `net9.0`. (The preferred xunit unit test can't restore packages offline in this environment, and a file-based `dotnet run app.cs` repro requires a .NET 10+ SDK.)
